doc: Nearest-texel lookup field[trunc(y m) % m, trunc(x m) % m] on a 22x22 field whose value is row * 22 + col (so the output names both indices): points at k/22 (15/22 * 22 = 14.999999999999998 truncates to 14), exactly 1.0 and just below (wrap to 0 / last texel), NEGATIVE points (astype(int64) truncates toward zero, so -1e-9 and -0.03 give index 0, not 21; -0.07 gives -1 % 22 = 21), points beyond one tile (1.5, 2.25, 1e9) and random points. The field is SQUARE: _sample is only defined for square fields (m = shape[0] indexes both axes, see sample.non_square.rows_index_both_axes.5x9). Pure selection of a float64 array: exact.
